ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region covering the central and lower fluke area. High-intensity mottling and contiguous white patches are mapped primarily to the distal tips, with a high concentration of light-grey/white pixels on the right lobe (viewer perspective) distal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a shallow vertical depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable high-amplitude jaggedness and irregular pixel-valleys at the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch extending to sharply tapered, slightly upturned distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel rings (dark centers with light peripheries) clustered on the right distal lobe. Isolated circular scars are distributed along the lower-center of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the left lobe near the leading edge and horizontally across the center-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue degradation or jagged scarring at the extreme distal points of both lobes, particularly the right side which exhibits a shredded trailing edge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'halo' scar patterns concentrated heavily on the right lobe distal region, creating a distinctive mottled texture.
